title: Unit 29 Consolidation: Human Rights & Justice
goal: Consolidate compound ser passives, formal purpose clauses, aun cuando, present perfect subjunctive, and indirect inquiries

items: I can report obligations, violations, and mandates using compound ser passives and formal purpose connectors.
I can express universal safeguards with aun cuando, evaluate compliance with the present perfect subjunctive, and report formal inquiries.
I can use Unit 29 human-rights and justice vocabulary accurately in C1 reports and dialogue.
